problem_register_binding.summary: Restore V10 conversation-first Strategy Workshop UX: start workshop creation with a multi-line zh-TW strategy description and optional derived title, default composer to the trader's own servant without requiring persona selection, render the strategy reconstruction card and 12-block completeness rail in zh-TW with the five V10 block states and clickable high-value decision options wired to POST /bff/agora/workshops/{id}/decisions, format opinion candidate measures as labelled fields with engineering details in expandable sections, treat no_trader_meetings as a zh-TW empty state, derive interaction summary status from participant completion, wire VersionCompareCard and BacktestResultCard with non-empty version patch enforcement, and replace all bg-white/slate-* light classes across workshop components with dark-theme tokens.

AC1_create_workshop_multiline_zh_descrip.implementation: Updated WorkshopListView.tsx with V10 Artboard 1 zh-TW copy, a multi-line strategy description textarea (create-workshop-description-input), V10 focus tags (create-workshop-focus-tags), an optional strategy title input (create-workshop-title-input) that automatically derives the title via deriveWorkshopTitleFromDescription when left empty (create-workshop-derived-title), and markWorkshopPendingInitialReconstruction(workshopId) so newly created workshops with a strategy description trigger initial strategy reconstruction on load.
tests: src/agora/pages/strategy-workshop/StrategyWorkshopPage.test.tsx > AC1: creates a workshop from a multi-line zh-TW strategy description, derives the title when empty, and triggers initial reconstruction
e2e/agora-persona-workshop-navigation.spec.ts > creating a Workshop from a zh-TW strategy description reconstructs the strategy, renders the 12-block rail, and submits a decision option

AC2_servant_default_composer_and_optiona.implementation: Updated WorkshopSessionView.tsx and participantPicker.ts so regular workshop sessions default to servant-only conversation (pickerMode = 'none', servant-default-composer-badge) without requiring persona selection. Added an optional Persona consultation add-on toggle (persona-consult-addon-toggle) exposing Ask/Challenge/Compare/Propose/Reflect modes and participant selection, while allowing the trader to send messages to their own servant even when zero eligible personas are available.
tests: src/agora/pages/strategy-workshop/StrategyWorkshopPage.test.tsx > AC2: sends to the trader's own servant by default when no eligible personas exist and exposes optional persona consultation add-on

AC3_zh_reconstruction_card_twelve_block_.implementation: Updated workshopCompletenessDisplay.ts, StrategyCompletenessRail.tsx, WorkshopCardRenderer.tsx, and WorkshopSessionView.tsx to render the V10 12-block completeness rail (v10-twelve-blocks-section) with the five V10 states (已確認, 助理推定, 尚缺, 薄弱, 衝突), block notes, and next high-value decision options (rail-decision-option-*) plus servant default option wired to postWorkshopDecision (POST /bff/agora/workshops/{id}/decisions) followed by reconstructWorkshopStrategy. Added typed reconstruction failure reason display (workshop-reconstruction-failure-reason) and retry button (workshop-reconstruction-retry-btn).
tests: src/agora/components/StrategyCompletenessRail.test.tsx > renders V10 twelve blocks with five states, notes, and submits clickable next high-value decision options

src/agora/pages/strategy-workshop/StrategyWorkshopPage.test.tsx > AC3: renders 12-block rail and submits clickable high-value decision option through POST /decisions, and shows typed failure reason with retry

AC4_opinion_candidate_measures_labelled_.implementation: Updated PersonaOpinionCard.tsx, WorkshopCardPrimitives.tsx, and WorkshopCardRenderer.tsx so candidate measures render as labelled readable fields (measure-item-*) instead of raw JSON, and moved raw identifiers, hashes, and provenance metadata into collapsed expandable engineering details sections (V10 §2.2).

AC5_no_trader_meetings_zh_empty_state_an.implementation: Updated WorkshopDeliberativeMeetingsSection in WorkshopSessionView.tsx so empty_reason === 'no_trader_meetings' (or 'no_meetings') renders a zh-TW empty state (workshop-convened-meetings-empty) rather than a read failure. Updated DailyInteractionTimeline.tsx to derive interaction status from participant records so an interaction whose participants all succeeded renders as completed (已完成) instead of remaining stuck on running.
tests: src/agora/pages/strategy-workshop/StrategyWorkshopPage.test.tsx > AC5: shows a zh-TW empty state for no_trader_meetings instead of a read failure
src/agora/components/DailyInteractionTimeline.test.tsx > derives completed status instead of running when all participants succeeded (AC5)

AC6_version_selection_comparison_backtes.implementation: Wired BacktestResultCard inside WorkshopCardRenderer.tsx for research_result cards with backtest metrics/equity/drawdown/trades/validation payload. Wired VersionCompareCard and version selection (selectWorkshopVersion) in WorkshopSessionView.tsx (workshop-versions-panel, workshop-version-compare-section). Enforced non-empty patch validation in both createWorkshopVersion (workshops.ts) and the + Version Patch action (cmd-version-btn) in WorkshopSessionView.tsx.
tests: src/agora/pages/strategy-workshop/StrategyWorkshopPage.test.tsx > AC6: wires version selection and VersionCompareCard in the versions panel and prevents empty version patches
src/agora/components/WorkshopCardRenderer.test.tsx > delegates research_result with backtest payload to BacktestResultCard (AC6)
src/lib/bff-v1/agora/workshops.test.ts > createWorkshopVersion > never submits an empty patch array

AC7_dark_theme_tokens_zh_tw_locales_and_.implementation: Replaced all bg-white and slate-* light-palette classes across every workshop card, rail, timeline, research panel, and strategy-workshop page with dark-theme tokens (bg-card, bg-muted, border-border, text-foreground, text-muted-foreground). Added zh-TW and en-US locale entries under agora.workshop and verified contract alignment via npm run test:contract.
